meta_description: Peter's Painting provides expert interior and exterior painting and decorating across Birmingham. Free quotes, reliable service. Call 07732 492057 today.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to stunning interiors — we handle residential and commercial projects with care, precision, and attention to detail.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services in Birmingham
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room refresh or a full house renovation, we deliver professional results on time and within budget.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh your living spaces with expert interior painting. We prepare surfaces properly, use premium finishes, and leave your home spotless. Walls, ceilings, woodwork — all covered.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and enhance your home's exterior. We handle everything from weathered brickwork to rendered walls, using exterior-grade paints built to withstand the British climate.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, window frames, and fitted furniture deserve expert finishing. We sand, prime, and apply durable topcoats for a professional look that lasts.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Transform offices, shops, and commercial spaces with minimal disruption. We work flexibly around business hours and maintain strict site standards.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Create visual interest with professional wallpapering and bespoke feature walls. We handle everything from contemporary designs to traditional patterns.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Treatment
services.desc: Proper preparation ensures lasting results. We strip, fill, sand, and treat surfaces thoroughly — the difference between a quick paint job and one that lasts for years.

about_pullquote: I do the work I'd want done on my own home — no shortcuts, no surprises.
about_para_1: Peter's Painting was established over two decades ago on a simple principle: deliver honest, skilled decorating work at fair prices. Based in Birmingham, we've built our reputation by showing up on time, finishing on schedule, and leaving every job cleaner than we found it. Peter and the team have worked on hundreds of homes and commercial properties across the West Midlands.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen to what you want, provide realistic timescales, and never oversell a job. We're not the flashiest operation, but we're reliable, straightforward, and produce results that speak for themselves. Many of our best work comes from word-of-mouth recommendations from happy clients who've used us multiple times.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had Peter and his team in to redecorate our lounge and hallway. They were punctual, tidy, and the finish is absolutely brilliant. Looked at quotes from three other painters but Peter's attention to detail won us over. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Needed exterior rendering done after rising damp work. Peter explained everything clearly, didn't rush the prep work, and the finish has held up perfectly through the winter. Fair pricing too, no hidden costs. Top bloke.
reviews.author: David C.

reviews.text: Used Peter's for a commercial office refresh. Worked around our hours, kept disruption minimal, and cleaned up daily. The team were professional and friendly. Already booking them in for phase two.
reviews.author: Jennifer L.
